title: UK Government to Add £120M in Funding for National AI Biosecurity Lab

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The British government is expanding its capacity to monitor the intersection of synthetic intelligence and pathogen research by increasing the budget for its national security research center. The administration plans to allocate another £120 million, or roughly $160 million, to the AI Biosecurity Lab to enhance its ability to detect and mitigate the risk of biological threats that could be accelerated by frontier AI.

The facility was launched with an initial £100 million in government funding as part of a broader £165 million national biosecurity initiative. The lab operates in partnership with Google DeepMind, OpenAI, and Anthropic, with the latter two providing £200 million in AI model credits to help the government develop medical countermeasures and identify emerging risks.
